messages:
claire: Quick thought after the IA workshop: instead of a single "Workloads" umbrella, what if we use a two-axis rail: primary group (Workloads, Data, Settings) + a compact secondary selector (Models | Pipelines | Jobs) that sits inside the breadcrumb row when the rail is collapsed. Idea is to save vertical space but keep discovery via the breadcrumb micro-selector. Prototype in figma linked. Thoughts?

jon: Interesting. So breadcrumb becomes interactive (not just path). That could help discoverability. Concern: keyboard discoverability and screenreader semantics. Need clear role and focus behavior.

akira: Love the compact selector concept. From routing POV we should pick a canonical URL scheme and keep legacy redirects. Proposal: canonical: `/console/:org/nav/:kind/:id`. Keep server 301 from `/console/:org/models/:id` -> `/console/:org/nav/models/:id`. Client uses router.replace on load for legacy paths.

pat: UX detail: micro-selector inside breadcrumb should show the active type and allow arrow-key switching between types. When a deep-link targets an item in a collapsed type, we should: 1) replace legacy path if needed, 2) expand the selector in-place (no full rail expand), 3) focus the target row with `preventScroll: true`, 4) announce with aria-live "Models opened". Avoid changing overall page scroll.

claire: Nice. For compact crumb copy let's show short badges: "M: Models", "P: Pipelines" on hover, but show just "M" in the collapsed state. Also add a small chevron affordance to indicate it's a control.

jon: Router pseudocode (very small):
```
// on route change
if (path.match(/^\/console\/.+\/models\/)) {
  const newPath = path.replace('/models/', '/nav/models/')
  router.replace(newPath)
  analytics.track('legacy_redirect', {from: path})
}
```
Server should mirror with 301 for shared links.

akira: Tests I will add: server 301 for legacy, client router.replace for legacy with no extra history entry, deep-link into collapsed selector expands the micro-selector and focuses row, animation <= 220ms, focus-without-scroll preserved.

pat: Accessibility checklist I'll prepare: interactive breadcrumb role (combobox vs menu?), keyboard arrow semantics, aria-live announcement when selector expands, visible focus ring on breadcrumb chip, and screenreader label for the micro-selector. Test matrix: VoiceOver, NVDA, TalkBack.

claire: Search implications: when someone types "models" surface a pinned action "Open Models in breadcrumb" that triggers the micro-selector expansion. Also update docs and quickstart snippets referencing legacy `/models/` links.

aria-bot: Reminder: add prototype and checklist to Friday design review doc.

jon: One micro-copy nit: when replacing a legacy path, include a short banner snackbar "Link auto-updated to new nav" with a CTA "View original" for users who want to see the old path. That helps debugging external links. Keep it dismissible.

claire: Great idea. Ok action list: @akira implement redirects + tests, @pat write a11y checklist and keyboard specs, @jon add small router middleware + snackbar UX, @claire update figma + docs. We'll run a small beta after tests pass. Thanks :thumbsup:
